title: A Turminha da Floresta e o Trem das Cores (Seedance 2.5)
description: Full episode workflow: 4 consistent characters (Tico, Bibi, Nino, Luma) + magical rainbow train. Every scene renders with Seedance 2.5 reference-to-video for character consistency, native PT-BR lip-synced dialogue and sound effects. See docs/visual-bible-turminha-da-floresta.md.

nodes.prompt: VISUAL BIBLE / CHARACTER CONSISTENCY — use the exact characters from the reference images: @Image1 = TICO (red squirrel boy, cinnamon-red fur, huge fluffy tail, red neckerchief, signature color RED). @Image2 = BIBI (round sky-blue bird chick girl, blue bow, orange beak, signature color BLUE). @Image3 = NINO (chubby honey-yellow bear cub, yellow overalls with sun patch, signature color YELLOW). @Image4 = LUMA (gentle lavender-purple fawn girl, glowing star spots, purple flower behind ear, signature color PURPLE). @Image5 = O TREM DAS CORES (cute smiling rainbow steam train with red, blue, yellow and purple wagons). STYLE: premium 3D CGI children's animation, Pixar-quality render, soft rounded toy-like shapes, big expressive eyes, velvety fur, saturated candy colors, warm sunset lighting, soft magical floating particles, colorful enchanted forest, 16:9, 4K, clean composition. Dialogue is spoken in Brazilian Portuguese with cute child-like voices and lip-sync. Preschool audience: cheerful, gentle, never scary. Leave a short visual pause after each color reveal so a child can repeat the color.
TICO — red squirrel boy reference sheet (Visual Bible)
BIBI — blue bird chick girl reference sheet (Visual Bible)
NINO — yellow bear cub reference sheet (Visual Bible)
LUMA — purple fawn girl reference sheet (Visual Bible)
O TREM DAS CORES — magical rainbow train reference (Visual Bible)
FINAL SCENE keyframe — the four friends in front of the train at the color festival, four glowing color symbols above (Visual Bible)

CENA 1 — O TREM PAROU! Happy upbeat music. The magical rainbow train @Image5 arrives at a wooden station in the middle of the colorful forest and stops with two cute whistles ('PII… PII…'). @Image1 Tico points excitedly and shouts: 'Olha, olha! O trem chegou!'. @Image2 Bibi flutters her little wings: 'Vamos para o Festival das Cores!'. @Image4 Luma trots in: 'Esperem!'. The train's lights blink off and it stops. @Image3 Nino tilts his head: 'Ué! Por que ele parou?'. Luma notices the empty color plate slots on the train's side: 'As placas das cores desapareceram!'. Tico: 'Sem as placas, não sabemos qual caminho seguir!'. Bibi: 'Então vamos procurar!'. All four together, fists up: 'Vamos!'. Camera: wide establishing shot of train arriving → medium group shot → close-ups on each speaking character. Warm morning light, magical particles.

CENA 3 — A COR ESCONDIDA. Playful investigation music. In the colorful forest, @Image2 Bibi says: 'Agora precisamos encontrar outra cor.'. @Image1 Tico peeks up a tree: 'Será que está na árvore?'. @Image3 Nino shakes his head: 'Não!'. @Image4 Luma looks behind a big round rock: 'Será que está atrás da pedra?'. Nino: 'Também não!'. A beautiful glowing BLUE butterfly flies across the frame. Bibi points: 'Ali!'. Tico: 'Uma borboleta!'. Luma turns to the camera: 'Que cor ela tem?'. Short pause, characters look at the camera waiting for the child to answer. Then all together, jumping happily: 'AZUL!'. A glowing BLUE color plate appears with a magical sparkle effect and floats. Nino: 'Achamos!'. Bibi hops singing: 'Azul, azul, azul!'. All sing a tiny repetitive song: 'Vermelho e azul! Vermelho e azul! Duas cores já encontramos!'. Camera: medium group shots, close-up on the blue butterfly, direct-to-camera interaction beat. Warm light, magical particles.

CENA 4 — NINO APERTA O BOTÃO ERRADO. The four friends are back at the train @Image5. @Image3 Nino marches confidently to the control panel: 'Eu sei ligar o trem!'. @Image4 Luma worried: 'Cuidado, Nino!'. Nino: 'É só apertar este botão!'. He presses a big silly button — the train makes a funny honking noise and blows colorful soap BUBBLES everywhere. Nino, covered in bubbles: 'Ops!'. Everyone giggles. @Image1 Tico laughing: 'Esse botão não!'. Luma gently: 'Vamos tentar juntos.'. All four place their paws on the big green button and count: 'Um… dois… três!'. The train whistles 'PIII!' and a happy green light turns on. @Image2 Bibi cheers: 'Funcionou!'. Nino proud: 'Eu sabia!'. Luma teasing kindly: 'Você apertou o botão errado.'. Nino grins: 'Eu sabia errado!'. Everyone bursts into warm laughter. Camera: medium shots on the control panel, comedic close-up of Nino with bubbles, joyful group shot. Bubbles, sparkles, warm light.

CENA 5 — A COR AMARELA. The train @Image5 rolls slowly through the forest with the four friends aboard, leaning out of the colorful wagons. @Image2 Bibi points ahead: 'Olhem para a frente!'. A huge field full of colorful flowers opens up. @Image1 Tico amazed: 'Quantas flores!'. @Image4 Luma turns to the camera: 'Encontrem uma flor amarela!'. Pause — the camera slowly pans across the flower field so the child can search; characters look toward the camera expectantly. @Image3 Nino points at a big sunflower: 'Ali!'. All together, jumping: 'AMARELA!'. @Image2 Bibi twirls: 'Amarelo como o sol!'. A glowing YELLOW color plate appears with a magical sparkle effect. All chant happily: 'Vermelho! Azul! Amarelo!'. Camera: gentle traveling shot alongside the train → wide flower field pan → close-up of the yellow flower → cheerful group shot. Golden light, petals floating, magical particles.

CENA 6 — O DESAFIO DOS MOVIMENTOS. In front of a cute wooden bridge over a sparkling stream in the colorful forest. @Image4 Luma explains: 'Para pegar a próxima placa, precisamos atravessar a ponte.'. @Image3 Nino pumped: 'Eu consigo!'. @Image1 Tico: 'Mas precisamos seguir os movimentos!'. Movement game, characters face the camera in a row inviting the child to copy: Luma: 'Um passo para frente!' — all four take one step forward. @Image2 Bibi: 'Um passo para trás!' — all step back. Tico: 'Agora para o lado!' — all hop to the side. Nino builds suspense: 'E agora…'. All shout together: 'PULA!' — everyone jumps high with joy, sparkles burst. Bibi claps her wings: 'Muito bem!'. Camera: front-facing full-body group shot like a dance-along, slight low angle, direct-to-camera interaction. Bouncy rhythm, cheerful sound effects, warm light.

CENA 7 — A ÚLTIMA PLACA. The sky turns golden at sunset. Near the train @Image5, @Image1 Tico announces: 'Só falta uma placa!'. @Image4 Luma: 'Precisamos procurar juntos.'. @Image3 Nino squints: 'Estou vendo alguma coisa!'. A tiny bright star-like glow twinkles near the train wheels. @Image2 Bibi gasps with joy: 'É uma placa roxa!'. Luma smiles: 'Isso mesmo!'. Short pause looking at the camera, then all together: 'ROXO!'. The glowing PURPLE plate floats up with a magical sparkle trail and slides into the train's slot. The train lights all turn on and it whistles loudly: 'PIIIII!'. Nino celebrates: 'O trem está funcionando!'. Camera: golden-hour wide shot → close-up of the twinkling purple plate → magical insert of the plate docking into the train → celebratory group shot. Golden sunset light, strong magical particles.

CENA 8 — O FESTIVAL DAS CORES. Joyful crescendo music. The train @Image5 arrives at a colorful festival square in the forest, decorated with paper garlands, lanterns and balloons. The four friends hop off. @Image1 Tico throws his arms up: 'Conseguimos!'. @Image2 Bibi: 'Encontramos todas as cores!'. @Image4 Luma warmly: 'E fizemos isso juntos.'. @Image3 Nino giggles: 'E eu apertei um botão errado!'. Everyone laughs kindly. Luma puts a hoof on Nino's shoulder: 'Mas você continuou tentando.'. Nino: 'Então tentar de novo é importante?'. Tico: 'Sempre!'. Bibi: 'E ajudar os amigos também!'. All four hold paws/wings, raise them together and cheer: 'Juntos conseguimos!'. Confetti and sparkles rain down. Camera: festive wide arrival shot → warm medium group circle → uplifting hero shot from slightly below. Sunset festival lighting, confetti, magical particles.

FINAL SCENE — CENA 9, ENCERRAMENTO INTERATIVO. Start exactly from the composition in @Image6. Cheerful final scene at the colorful forest festival. The four friends stand together in front of the magical train @Image5. Behind them, four large glowing color symbols appear ONE AT A TIME, each with a short magical sparkle effect and a brief visual pause after it so a child can repeat the color: first RED — @Image1 Tico points toward the red symbol and says 'Vermelho!'; pause. Then BLUE — @Image2 Bibi points toward the blue symbol: 'Azul!'; pause. Then YELLOW — @Image3 Nino points toward the yellow symbol: 'Amarelo!'; pause. Then PURPLE — @Image4 Luma points toward the purple symbol: 'Roxo!'; pause. All together: 'Muito bem!'. Then all four characters jump together and celebrate while the train behind them gently flashes its lights. Bibi turns toward the camera and asks the child: 'Qual foi a sua cor favorita?'. The characters pause and look directly into the camera, creating a strong feeling of interaction with the viewer. Nino smiles: 'A minha foi… todas!'. Everyone laughs warmly. The characters wave goodbye directly toward the camera: 'Tchauuuu!'. The train makes two cute cheerful whistle sounds: 'PII! PII!'. Ending: the train slowly moves away through the colorful forest while the four characters wave from the platform. Camera: front-facing character shot → individual color close-ups → group shot → direct-to-camera interaction → wide cinematic ending. Warm sunset lighting, soft magical particles, happy emotional ending. 16:9, premium 3D CGI children's animation, 4K, clean composition.
